    The ray table of the small ray category presents the algebra #

    For split basic data S of a distributive algebra, the ray table linTable k P of P = RaySmall S.toIdempotents.RayCategory is a ray presentation of B in the sense of the multiplicative-bases library: representatives of the rays are the chosen representatives of the unit orbits (SplitBasicData.isRayPres_linTable).
